title: I asked 100 companies for my data. Some deleted it instead.
content: Testing 100 companies found privacy requests often led to confusion and dead ends.

title: Think twice before installing this device promising free movies
content: In exchange for free stuff, devices make home connections part of a proxy network.

title: “Zlibrary my beloved”: Anthropic staff chats extolling piracy cited in Sony suit
content: Lawsuit: Anthropic’s torrenting totally screwed songwriters as AI songs top charts.

title: Kalshi bans George Santos for life over State of the Union bets
content: The disciplinary action comes two months after the Commodity Futures Trading Commission settled charges against Santos.

title: Polimill builds Japan's next-generation public AI infrastructure
content: Polimill uses OpenAI GPT models and Codex to help municipalities search and use administrative knowledge while accelerating development.

title: Tim Cook’s parting message: Apple is in the hands of a product builder
content: Tim Cook’s farewell memo to Apple employees offers a glimpse at how he wants John Ternus to be seen: as a product builder with deep experience across the iPhone, Mac, AirPods, and other major hardware lines.

title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
content: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.

title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
content: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.

title: ChatGPT and Reddit now face EU's toughest online safety rules
content: Explosive growth comes with a new regulatory burden in the European Union.

title: NVIDIA and MediaTek Deepen Long-Standing Partnership to Build AI Edge to Cloud Computing Platforms
content: NVIDIA and MediaTek today announced a deepening of their longstanding collaboration to build the next generations of AI computing platforms — spanning AI infrastructure, local AI computing and automotive.

title: Hackers claim millions of patient records stolen during data breach at healthcare giant McKesson
content: The company, which distributes medicines and medical devices to hospitals and healthcare practices across the U.S., said it was hacked and expects intermittent service degradation.

title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
content: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.

title: How AI could make it harder for governments to use hacking tools
content: AI is proving effective at finding and exploiting vulnerabilities. Some say this will make it harder for governments to use hacking tools and spyware and could reignite calls to backdoor devices.

title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
content: Blue Voice is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can't access on the public internet.

title: VLC crosses 7 billion downloads
content: In our world of expensive streaming platforms, the very free and offline VLC media player has crossed 7 billion downloads.

title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
content: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.
